programs.name: European Master's in Project Management (EuroMPM)

requirements.value: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Science and/or Project Management and/or Computer Science, or a closely related field to the European Master's in Project Management, obtained from a university, polytechnic, university of applied sciences, or an accredited professional academy
requirements.sourceQuote: A Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Science and/or Project Management and/or Computer Science, or a closely related field to the European Master's in Project Management, obtained from a university, polytechnic, university of applied sciences, or an accredited professional academy

A degree in a related field must include a curriculum that covers relevant competencies in business administration and/or project management, and/or computer science, at an appropriate scale and level.
The final grade must be at least "good" (2.3).
